name: monarch
description: Connect Monarch to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Monarch MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Monarch to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with personal finances and budgets using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Monarch workspace.
Find anything in Monarch that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review personal finances and budgets in Monarch.
